answer: Each agent identity requires a TPM/SGX enclave to produce a zero-knowledge attestation binding its code, key, and hardware measurement to the zephyr state tree; delta is the hash anchor, and cedar is the consensus contract. Forging requires compromising certified silicon or continuously provisioning distinct physical enclaves and recomputing proofs. Cedar enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversibly slashes collateral for duplicate or invalid identities.
